list.title: Guides
list.lead: Plain-language guides for new potters: from what a glaze is to firing it, and keeping everyone safe on the way.
list.note: These guides gather what manufacturers, safety agencies and experienced potters publish, with the sources at the end of each. They are a starting point, not a substitute for your materials' safety data sheets, your kiln's manual or local rules.

glazingBasics.title: Glazing from first principles
glazingBasics.text: What a glaze is, how it melts, and every word you will meet on a recipe or a bag, explained.

makingAGlaze.title: How to make a glaze
makingAGlaze.text: Buying, storing, weighing, mixing and sieving a glaze, then testing it and keeping records.

safeMixing.title: Safe mixing and ventilation
safeMixing.text: Dust, respirators, cleaning, the materials that need most care, and venting the kiln.

homeSafety.title: Don't poison your family
homeSafety.text: Pottery at home with children and pets: storage, dust, the kiln, and what to do if something is swallowed.

firing.title: Firing a basic kiln
firing.text: Cones, kiln sitters and manual switches, with schedules for bisque and glaze firings.
